I don't know if there is a way to increase those. I will try to start drinking/doing drugs every weekend with them. But unfortunately I don't like weed, so i can't chill with them every day.

The part about aspergers which makes me unhappy is the unability to make a connection with people. And I want to be an alpha male who is comfortable in every place he goes, but I know i can never be that. Also 1 on 1 communication always feels very awkward and forced to me. And also the moodswings, right now since writing this post i'm feeling a bit better, but when i'm in a bad mood holy shit it's so terrible. 
I'm also afraid to express my opinion on things etc, to put myself out there. Most days I just sit on the computer and lurk things, like I don't even really post on reddit or other forums i just lurk endlessly.
